premises.text: Uniform field-wide fertilizer allocation from random paddock sampling wastes large amounts of fertilizer and yield across commodity crops
premises.evidence_span: up to 30% of all fertilizer applied is wasted, resulting in additional yield loss of up to 25%

premises.text: Precision satellite-guided prescription maps from infrared imagery put fertilizer only where and when needed
premises.evidence_span: We generate actionable prescription maps for fertilizer application using infrared pictures of the farms so that fertilizer can go only where it's needed exactly when it's required

premises.text: Farmers can see crop stress up to 10 days sooner than with traditional methods
premises.evidence_span: farmers can see the stress of their crops up to 10 days sooner that they can see it with traditional methods

premises.text: Platform workflow guides sampling, lab calibration of nitrogen maps, analytics, and zoning for variable-rate tractor application
premises.evidence_span: agronomist is guided where to go sample the crop, and then uses the crop test results from the lab to plug into the platform to calibrate the nitrogen maps

premises.text: Hyperspectral sensing plus farm-management-software integration pinpoints stressors and yields up to 3× competitors' productivity uplift
premises.evidence_span: Our hyperspectral sensing is allowing farmers to see the crop stress sooner and, moreover, pinpoint the stressor behind it

premises.text: Sold as annual subscriptions to commercial and independent agronomists, starting in wheat, canola, barley, and cotton
premises.evidence_span: Annual subscriptions, this is how we sell our product. We provide those to commercial and independent agronomists

domains.name: Satellite prescription maps and agronomist workflow

value.text: Grow more with less via precision fertilizer productivity uplift

secondary_value.text: Reduce environmental damage from wasted fertilizer
secondary_value.evidence_span: costing our planet $10 billion in environmental damage
